commit_message: Add ADR0126 Timeline foundation on current main
pr_title: GameEngine: complete ADR0126 Timeline and Sequencer
pr_body:
## Summary

Replays the reviewed ADR0126 Timeline foundation onto the exact current-main baseline after unrelated parallel ADR merges. The request remains a Draft PR and does not merge main.

This foundation provides the neutral Timeline clock/schedule/player, stable IDs and persistence, deterministic compile/evaluation, transactional authoring service, capability registry and CLI/MCP surfaces, and shared camera-selection override groundwork. Follow-up requests on this same current-main task branch complete the persisted first-release schema, exact Event crossing semantics, production runtime composition, Project Rust integration, dedicated Sequencer Editor, and required Windows/Visual Validation.
